items.title: Joseph’s brothers
items.charge: Envy, conspiracy to murder, selling their brother to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver, and deceiving their father with the bloodied coat

items.title: Judah and Tamar
items.charge: Withholding Shelah from his brother’s widow; going in to a woman he took for a harlot by her attire

items.title: Saul of Tarsus
items.charge: Persecuting the church; consenting to Stephen’s death; compelling the saints to blaspheme

items.title: Saul’s rash oath, and the people at the blood
items.charge: A strange oath that distressed the army; the people eating flesh with the blood; the king ready to kill the son who had wrought the salvation

items.title: The Samaritan village, and the sons of thunder
items.charge: Refusing to receive him because his face was toward Jerusalem; James and John asking for fire from heaven
